|{2:,* TODO An escaped headline}|
|{3:#+TITLE:}{2: }{4:A title}|
|{2:Some *}{5:bold}{2:* and }{6:[[https://orgmode.org][a link]]}{2:.}|
|{7:-}{2: }{8:[X]}{2: done }{9:<2026-10-01 Thu>}|
|{10:|}{11: a }{10:|}{11: b }{10:|}|
|{1:#+end_src}|
|Some {12:bold} and {13:a link}.|

{1} OrgBlockDelimiter -> Comment
{2} OrgBlock -> String
{3} OrgBlock -> String | orgTitleKeyword -> OrgKeyword -> PreProc
{4} OrgBlock -> String | OrgTitle -> Title [bold]
{5} OrgBlock -> String | OrgBold [bold]
{6} OrgBlock -> String | OrgLink -> @markup.link [underline]
{7} OrgBlock -> String | OrgListBullet -> Special
{8} OrgBlock -> String | OrgCheckboxChecked -> DiagnosticOk
{9} OrgBlock -> String | OrgTimestamp -> Underlined [underline]
{10} OrgBlock -> String | OrgTable -> Normal | OrgTableSeparator -> Delimiter
{11} OrgBlock -> String | OrgTable -> Normal
{12} OrgBold [bold]
{13} OrgLink -> @markup.link [underline]
